outcome: Recommendation of caesarean sections to prevent HBV transmission
Recommendation of withholding breastfeeding to prevent HBV transmission
cohort: The study included 506 primary healthcare physicians (PHPs) randomly selected from medical facilities in Georgia's six largest cities.
finding: PHPs with higher HBV knowledge were less likely to provide inaccurate instructions to their patients, including recommending 'hepatoprotective' medications, caesarean sections, and withholding breastfeeding.
mod_finding: PHPs with a high knowledge score were less likely to recommend caesarean sections (aOR 0.47) and withholding breastfeeding (aOR 0.57) to prevent HBV transmission.
